about_the_game:
A father’s desperate journey on the edge of reality and madness.

After his wife and young daughter die under tragic circumstances near their new countryside home, a university professor cannot accept the loss. Driven by grief and guilt, he returns to the house to uncover the truth – or perhaps to change it. But as he digs deeper into the darkness of the past, reality itself begins to fracture, and something sinister reaches out for him from beyond the grave.

AMIRA is a single-player, narrative-driven psychological horror game exploring themes of grief, letting go, and obsession.

Key Features:

  • A heartbreaking story of a father unable to let go of his lost daughter.

  • Puzzle-based progression, where logic and observation are just as vital as courage.

  • A suffocating atmosphere and haunting audiovisual experience that keeps players under constant tension – even without combat.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains scenes of psychological horror, grief, and disturbing imagery.
It includes themes of death, loss, and trauma.
There are no sexual acts, drug use, or explicit violence.
Sensitive players should be aware of emotionally intense content.

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5600X / Intel Core i5-10600K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM

short_description: AMIRA is a psychological horror game in which a grieving father tries to uncover what happened to his family. During his investigation, he stumbles upon horrific secrets from both the past and the present.
